def find_grid_grud_shift_rows(r, seed):
    left = find_result_row(
        "Exp3A Structured frequency shift", 12, r,
        "structured-r{}->structured-r{}".format(r, r), "train_matched", seed)
    right = find_result_row(
        "Exp3A Structured frequency shift", 12, r,
        "dense->structured-r{}".format(r), "train_matched", seed)
    return left, right


def four_prediction_frame(grid_matched_df, grid_mismatch_df, raw_matched_df, raw_mismatch_df):
    base = grid_matched_df[["stay", "patient_id", "y_true", "prediction"]].rename(
        columns={"prediction": "pred_grid_matched"})
    frames = [
        (grid_mismatch_df, "pred_grid_mismatch"),
        (raw_matched_df, "pred_raw_matched"),
        (raw_mismatch_df, "pred_raw_mismatch"),
    ]
    merged = base
    for df, pred_col in frames:
        part = df[["stay", "patient_id", "y_true", "prediction"]].rename(
            columns={"y_true": "y_check", "prediction": pred_col})
        merged = merged.merge(part, on=["stay", "patient_id"], how="inner")
        if not np.array_equal(merged["y_true"].values, merged["y_check"].values):
            raise ValueError("Grid/raw four-prediction comparison has inconsistent y_true labels.")
        merged = merged.drop(["y_check"], axis=1)
    expected_n = len(grid_matched_df)
    if any(len(df) != expected_n for df in [grid_mismatch_df, raw_matched_df, raw_mismatch_df]) or len(merged) != expected_n:
        raise ValueError("Grid/raw four-prediction comparison has different stay sets.")
    return merged.reset_index(drop=True)


def shift_values_from_four_frame(frame, metric, indices=None):
    if indices is None:
        indices = np.arange(len(frame))
    y = frame["y_true"].values[indices]
    grid_matched = compute_metric(y, frame["pred_grid_matched"].values[indices], metric)
    grid_mismatch = compute_metric(y, frame["pred_grid_mismatch"].values[indices], metric)
    raw_matched = compute_metric(y, frame["pred_raw_matched"].values[indices], metric)
    raw_mismatch = compute_metric(y, frame["pred_raw_mismatch"].values[indices], metric)
    grid_shift = metric_difference(grid_matched, grid_mismatch, metric)
    raw_shift = metric_difference(raw_matched, raw_mismatch, metric)
    return grid_shift, raw_shift, grid_shift - raw_shift


def grid_vs_raw_shift_patient_bootstrap(frame, metric, n_boot=2000, random_state=DEFAULT_BOOTSTRAP_SEED):
    grid_shift, raw_shift, grid_minus_raw = shift_values_from_four_frame(frame, metric)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    patient_ids = np.asarray(sorted(frame["patient_id"].unique()))
    patient_to_indices = {pid: np.where(frame["patient_id"].values == pid)[0] for pid in patient_ids}
    boot = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        sampled_patients = rng.choice(patient_ids, size=len(patient_ids), replace=True)
        sampled_indices = np.concatenate([patient_to_indices[pid] for pid in sampled_patients])
        _, _, diff = shift_values_from_four_frame(frame, metric, sampled_indices)
        if not np.isnan(diff):
            boot.append(diff)
    boot = np.asarray(boot)
    if len(boot):
        ci_low, ci_high = np.percentile(boot, [2.5, 97.5])
    else:
        ci_low, ci_high = np.nan, np.nan
    return {
        "grid_shift": grid_shift,
        "raw_shift": raw_shift,
        "grid_minus_raw_shift": grid_minus_raw,
        "ci_low": float(ci_low) if not np.isnan(ci_low) else np.nan,
        "ci_high": float(ci_high) if not np.isnan(ci_high) else np.nan,
        "n_patients": int(len(patient_ids)),
        "n_stays": int(len(frame)),
        "n_boot_valid": int(len(boot)),
    }


def across_seed_grid_vs_raw_shift_bootstrap(records, metric, n_boot=2000, random_state=DEFAULT_BOOTSTRAP_SEED):
    frames_by_seed = {}
    first_patients = None
    point_rows = []
    for record in records:
        seed = int(record["seed"])
        frame = record["frame"]
        patients = np.asarray(sorted(frame["patient_id"].unique()))
        if first_patients is None:
            first_patients = patients
        elif not np.array_equal(first_patients, patients):
            raise ValueError("Patient sets differ across seeds for grid-vs-raw GRU-D metric {}".format(metric))
        point_rows.append(shift_values_from_four_frame(frame, metric))
        frames_by_seed[seed] = frame
    if first_patients is None:
        return {"mean_grid_shift": np.nan, "mean_raw_shift": np.nan, "mean_grid_minus_raw_shift": np.nan,
                "patient_bootstrap_ci_low": np.nan, "patient_bootstrap_ci_high": np.nan}
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    patient_ids = first_patients
    patient_to_indices = {
        seed: {pid: np.where(frame["patient_id"].values == pid)[0] for pid in patient_ids}
        for seed, frame in frames_by_seed.items()
    }
    boot_means = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        sampled_patients = rng.choice(patient_ids, size=len(patient_ids), replace=True)
        seed_diffs = []
        for seed, frame in frames_by_seed.items():
            sampled_indices = np.concatenate([patient_to_indices[seed][pid] for pid in sampled_patients])
            _, _, diff = shift_values_from_four_frame(frame, metric, sampled_indices)
            if not np.isnan(diff):
                seed_diffs.append(diff)
        if len(seed_diffs):
            boot_means.append(float(np.mean(seed_diffs)))
    boot_means = np.asarray(boot_means)
    if len(boot_means):
        ci_low, ci_high = np.percentile(boot_means, [2.5, 97.5])
    else:
        ci_low, ci_high = np.nan, np.nan
    point_rows = np.asarray(point_rows)
    return {
        "mean_grid_shift": float(np.mean(point_rows[:, 0])),
        "mean_raw_shift": float(np.mean(point_rows[:, 1])),
        "mean_grid_minus_raw_shift": float(np.mean(point_rows[:, 2])),
        "patient_bootstrap_ci_low": float(ci_low) if not np.isnan(ci_low) else np.nan,
        "patient_bootstrap_ci_high": float(ci_high) if not np.isnan(ci_high) else np.nan,
        "boot_diffs": boot_means,
    }


grid_vs_raw_rows = []
grid_vs_raw_records = []
for r in EXP3E_GRUD_RAW_RS:
    raw_left_condition = "raw-structured-r{}->raw-structured-r{}".format(r, r)
    raw_right_condition = "raw-dense->raw-structured-r{}".format(r)
    for seed in sorted(EXP3_GRUD_EXPECTED_MODEL_SEEDS):
        grid_left, grid_right = find_grid_grud_shift_rows(r, seed)
        raw_left = find_raw_grud_result_row(r, raw_left_condition, seed)
        raw_right = find_raw_grud_result_row(r, raw_right_condition, seed)
        if grid_left is None or grid_right is None or raw_left is None or raw_right is None:
            continue
        grid_left_key = prediction_identity(grid_left)
        grid_right_key = prediction_identity(grid_right)
        raw_left_key = raw_grud_prediction_identity(raw_left)
        raw_right_key = raw_grud_prediction_identity(raw_right)
        frame = four_prediction_frame(
            exp3_grud_predictions[grid_left_key], exp3_grud_predictions[grid_right_key],
            exp3e_grud_raw_predictions[raw_left_key], exp3e_grud_raw_predictions[raw_right_key])
        for metric in EXP3_GRUD_METRICS:
            boot_seed = EXP3_GRUD_BOOTSTRAP_SEED + 400000 + int(r) * 1000 + int(seed) * 10 + EXP3_GRUD_METRICS.index(metric)
            boot = grid_vs_raw_shift_patient_bootstrap(frame, metric=metric, n_boot=EXP3_GRUD_N_BOOT, random_state=boot_seed)
            grid_vs_raw_rows.append({
                "r": int(r),
                "model_seed": int(seed),
                "seed": int(seed),
                "metric": metric,
                "grid_shift": boot["grid_shift"],
                "raw_shift": boot["raw_shift"],
                "grid_minus_raw_shift": boot["grid_minus_raw_shift"],
                "patient_bootstrap_ci_low": boot["ci_low"],
                "patient_bootstrap_ci_high": boot["ci_high"],
                "n_patients": boot["n_patients"],
                "n_stays": boot["n_stays"],
                "n_boot_valid": boot["n_boot_valid"],
                "grid_matched_prediction_key": grid_left_key,
                "grid_mismatched_prediction_key": grid_right_key,
                "raw_matched_prediction_key": raw_left_key,
                "raw_mismatched_prediction_key": raw_right_key,
                "verified_same_test_examples": True,
                "comparison_orientation": "grid shift - raw shift; positive means grid penalty larger",
            })
            grid_vs_raw_records.append({"r": int(r), "seed": int(seed), "metric": metric, "frame": frame})

exp3_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift_contrasts = pd.DataFrame(grid_vs_raw_rows)
show_table("Exp3E GRU-D grid-vs-raw shift seed-level contrasts", exp3_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift_contrasts, max_rows=300)

summary_rows = []
if len(exp3_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift_contrasts):
    for (r, metric), group in exp3_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift_contrasts.groupby(["r", "metric"]):
        seeds = sorted(group["model_seed"].astype(int).unique().tolist())
        observed = set(seeds)
        complete_seed_set = observed == EXP3_GRUD_EXPECTED_MODEL_SEEDS
        if not complete_seed_set:
            print("PARTIAL GRU-D GRID-VS-RAW SEED SET: r={} metric={} observed={} missing={} extra={}".format(
                r, metric, seeds, sorted(EXP3_GRUD_EXPECTED_MODEL_SEEDS - observed), sorted(observed - EXP3_GRUD_EXPECTED_MODEL_SEEDS)))
            if not EXP3_GRUD_ALLOW_PARTIAL_RESULTS:
                continue
        records = [rec for rec in grid_vs_raw_records if int(rec["r"]) == int(r) and rec["metric"] == metric]
        boot = across_seed_grid_vs_raw_shift_bootstrap(
            records, metric=metric, n_boot=EXP3_GRUD_N_BOOT,
            random_state=EXP3_GRUD_BOOTSTRAP_SEED + 410000 + int(r) * 1000 + EXP3_GRUD_METRICS.index(metric))
        diffs = group["grid_minus_raw_shift"].astype(float).values
        summary_rows.append({
            "r": int(r),
            "metric": metric,
            "mean_grid_shift": boot["mean_grid_shift"],
            "mean_raw_shift": boot["mean_raw_shift"],
            "mean_grid_minus_raw_shift": boot["mean_grid_minus_raw_shift"],
            "sd_grid_minus_raw_shift": float(np.std(diffs, ddof=1)) if len(diffs) > 1 else np.nan,
            "n_seeds": int(len(seeds)),
            "expected_seeds": int(len(EXP3_GRUD_EXPECTED_MODEL_SEEDS)),
            "complete_seed_set": complete_seed_set,
            "patient_bootstrap_ci_low": boot["patient_bootstrap_ci_low"],
            "patient_bootstrap_ci_high": boot["patient_bootstrap_ci_high"],
            "comparison_orientation": "grid shift - raw shift; positive means grid penalty larger",
        })
exp3_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift_summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
show_table("Exp3E GRU-D grid-vs-raw shift summary", exp3_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift_summary, max_rows=100)


def _grud_raw_shift_penalty_panel(ax, metric, title):
    sub = exp3e_grud_raw_shift_summary[exp3e_grud_raw_shift_summary["metric"] == metric].sort_values("r")
    if len(sub) == 0:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "NOT AVAILABLE", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", va="center")
        ax.set_axis_off()
        return False
    x = np.arange(len(sub))
    y = sub["mean_difference"].values
    lo = sub["patient_bootstrap_ci_low"].values
    hi = sub["patient_bootstrap_ci_high"].values
    yerr = np.vstack([y - lo, hi - y])
    ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linewidth=1, linestyle="--")
    ax.errorbar(x, y, yerr=yerr, fmt="o", capsize=5, color="black", zorder=3)
    for i, r in enumerate(sub["r"].tolist()):
        raw = exp3e_grud_raw_shift_contrasts[
            (exp3e_grud_raw_shift_contrasts["metric"] == metric) &
            (exp3e_grud_raw_shift_contrasts["r"].astype(int) == int(r))]
        ax.scatter(np.repeat(i, len(raw)), raw["difference"].values, alpha=0.45, s=24)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([grud_interval_label(r) for r in sub["r"].tolist()])
    ax.set_xlabel("Raw irregular structured test interval")
    ax.set_ylabel("{} raw shift penalty\nmatched better +".format(metric.upper()))
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
    return True


def plot_grud_raw_shift_penalty_metrics(metrics=("auroc", "auprc")):
    if len(exp3e_grud_raw_shift_summary) == 0:
        print("Skipping raw GRU-D shift plot: no Exp3E raw summaries.")
        return
    labels = {"auroc": "AUROC", "auprc": "AUPRC"}
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(metrics), figsize=(6.2 * len(metrics), 4.4), sharex=False)
    axes = np.asarray(axes).reshape(-1)
    plotted = False
    for ax, metric in zip(axes, metrics):
        plotted = _grud_raw_shift_penalty_panel(
            ax, metric, "Exp3E raw GRU-D {} shift penalty".format(labels.get(metric, metric.upper()))
        ) or plotted
    if not plotted:
        plt.close(fig)
        return
    fig.suptitle(exp3_grud_title("Exp3E raw irregular-timestamp GRU-D shift penalty"), y=1.03)
    fig.tight_layout()
    output_path = EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / "experiment3e_grud_raw_shift_penalty_auroc_auprc_bootstrap_ci95.png"
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved:", output_path)


def _grud_grid_vs_raw_absolute_seed_values(records, metric):
    rows = []
    for record in records:
        if record["metric"] != metric:
            continue
        frame = record["frame"]
        y = frame["y_true"].values
        rows.append({
            "r": int(record["r"]),
            "seed": int(record["seed"]),
            "matched": compute_metric(y, frame["pred_grid_matched"].values, metric),
            "grid_shift": compute_metric(y, frame["pred_grid_mismatch"].values, metric),
            "raw_shift": compute_metric(y, frame["pred_raw_mismatch"].values, metric),
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def plot_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift(metric="auprc"):
    records = globals().get("grid_vs_raw_records", [])
    seed_values = _grud_grid_vs_raw_absolute_seed_values(records, metric)
    if len(seed_values) == 0:
        print("Skipping GRU-D grid-vs-raw plot: no seed-level absolute rows for metric {}.".format(metric))
        return
    categories = [
        ("matched", "Regular-grid (matched)", "tab:blue"),
        ("grid_shift", "Regular-grid (shifted)", "tab:orange"),
        ("raw_shift", "Raw/irregular (shifted)", "tab:green"),
    ]
    summary_long = seed_values.melt(
        id_vars=["r", "seed"],
        value_vars=[key for key, _, _ in categories],
        var_name="condition",
        value_name="value",
    )
    summary = summarize_with_t_ci(summary_long, ["r", "condition"], "value")
    r_values = sorted(set(int(r) for r in EXP3E_GRUD_RAW_RS) | set(summary["r"].astype(int)))
    x = np.arange(len(r_values))
    x_pos = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(r_values)}
    offsets = np.linspace(-0.16, 0.16, len(categories))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4, 5.2))
    for offset, (key, label, color) in zip(offsets, categories):
        sub = summary[summary["condition"] == key].sort_values("r")
        if len(sub):
            y = sub["mean"].astype(float).values
            lo = sub["ci95_low"].astype(float).values
            hi = sub["ci95_high"].astype(float).values
            xs = np.asarray([x_pos[int(r)] for r in sub["r"]]) + offset
            yerr = np.nan_to_num(np.vstack([np.maximum(y - lo, 0), np.maximum(hi - y, 0)]), nan=0.0)
            ax.errorbar(
                xs, y, yerr=yerr, fmt="o", linestyle="none", color=color,
                capsize=4, markersize=5, linewidth=1.2, label=label, zorder=3,
            )
            for plot_x, (_, row) in zip(xs, sub.iterrows()):
                ax.annotate("n={}".format(int(row["n"])), (plot_x, row["mean"]),
                            xytext=(0, 7), textcoords="offset points", ha="center",
                            fontsize=8, color=color)
        for r in r_values:
            points = seed_values[seed_values["r"].astype(int) == int(r)][key].astype(float).dropna().values
            if len(points):
                ax.scatter(np.repeat(x_pos[r] + offset, len(points)), points,
                           alpha=0.35, s=20, color=color, edgecolors="none", zorder=2)
    all_values = []
    for key, _, _ in categories:
        all_values.extend(seed_values[key].astype(float).dropna().tolist())
        ci = summary[summary["condition"] == key][["ci95_low", "ci95_high"]].astype(float).values
        all_values.extend(ci[np.isfinite(ci)].tolist())
    if all_values:
        ax.set_ylim(min(0.58, min(all_values) - 0.005), max(0.72, max(all_values) + 0.005))
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([grud_interval_label(r) for r in r_values])
    ax.set_xlabel("Test sampling interval")
    ax.set_ylabel("Test {}".format(metric.upper()))
    ax.set_title("GRU-D: Regular-grid vs raw representation under frequency shift")
    handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.94),
               ncol=len(categories), frameon=False, fontsize=9, columnspacing=1.2)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.76, bottom=0.16, left=0.12, right=0.98)
    output_path = EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / "experiment3_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift_{}.png".format(metric)
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved:", output_path)


plot_grud_raw_shift_penalty_metrics(("auroc", "auprc"))
plot_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift("auprc")
plot_grud_grid_vs_raw_shift("auroc")

Cross-Experiment GRU-D Summary¶

This compact table summarizes the main observation-regime mismatch effects and keeps seed CIs and patient-bootstrap CIs separate.

In [12]:
def format_ci(low, high):
    if pd.isnull(low) or pd.isnull(high):
        return "NA"
    return "[{:.4f}, {:.4f}]".format(float(low), float(high))


main_rows = []
if len(exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary):
    for experiment, horizon, r, contrast in EXP3_GRUD_MAIN_CONTRASTS:
        sub = exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary[
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["experiment"] == experiment) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["horizon"].astype(int) == int(horizon)) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["r"].astype(int) == int(r)) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["contrast"] == contrast) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["metric"].isin(["auprc", "auroc", "brier"]))
        ]
        for _, row in sub.iterrows():
            main_rows.append({
                "Experiment": experiment,
                "Horizon": int(row["horizon"]),
                "Sampling": row["sampling"],
                "r": int(row["r"]),
                "Metric": row["metric"].upper(),
                "Matched - mismatched": row["mean_difference"],
                "Seed CI": format_ci(row["student_t_ci95_low"], row["student_t_ci95_high"]),
                "Patient bootstrap CI": format_ci(row["patient_bootstrap_ci_low"], row["patient_bootstrap_ci_high"]),
                "n seeds": int(row["n_seeds"]),
                "complete_seed_set": bool(row["complete_seed_set"]),
                "orientation": row["difference_orientation"],
            })
exp3_grud_cross_experiment_summary = pd.DataFrame(main_rows)
show_table("GRU-D cross-experiment mismatch-effect summary", exp3_grud_cross_experiment_summary, max_rows=100)
if len(exp3_grud_cross_experiment_summary):
    exp3_grud_cross_experiment_summary.to_csv(
        EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / "experiment3_grud_cross_experiment_mismatch_summary.csv", index=False)

LSTM Inputs For Cross-Model Comparison¶

This section loads already-computed LSTM Experiment 3 result tables exported by visualize_exp3_frequency_shift.ipynb. The GRU-D notebook uses those tables only for descriptive cross-model tables and source figures; it does not retrain LSTM models or recompute LSTM predictions.

In [13]:
def lstm_notebook_saved_csvs():
    notebook_path = Path("visualize_exp3_frequency_shift.ipynb") if Path.cwd().name == "visualizers" else Path("visualizers/visualize_exp3_frequency_shift.ipynb")
    if not notebook_path.exists():
        return []
    text = notebook_path.read_text()
    return sorted(set(re.findall(r"to_csv\((?:[^\)]*)['\"]([^'\"]+\.csv)['\"]", text)))


def load_lstm_shift_summary_if_available():
    print("LSTM notebook literal to_csv outputs:", lstm_notebook_saved_csvs() or "<none found>")
    candidate_paths = [
        EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / "experiment3_lstm_combined_key_contrast_summary.csv",
        EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / "experiment3_combined_key_contrast_summary.csv",
    ]
    for candidate in candidate_paths:
        if candidate.exists():
            print("Using saved LSTM summary:", candidate)
            return pd.read_csv(candidate)
    if "exp3_combined_key_contrast_summary" in globals():
        print("Using in-memory LSTM exp3_combined_key_contrast_summary from this kernel.")
        return exp3_combined_key_contrast_summary.copy()
    print("Skipping optional LSTM comparison: no compatible saved or in-memory LSTM shift summary available.")
    return pd.DataFrame()


def side_by_side_lstm_grud(lstm_summary, grud_summary):
    if lstm_summary is None or len(lstm_summary) == 0 or grud_summary is None or len(grud_summary) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    mapping = [
        ("Exp3A Structured frequency shift", 12, 4, "structured shift", "structured r4, h=12"),
        ("Exp3A Structured frequency shift", 12, 8, "structured shift", "structured r8, h=12"),
        ("Exp3C Random-matched frequency shift", 12, 4, "random-matched shift", "random matched r4, h=12"),
        ("Exp3D Horizon replication", 96, 4, "structured shift", "structured r4, h=96"),
    ]
    rows = []
    for experiment, horizon, r, contrast, label in mapping:
        for metric in ["auprc", "auroc", "brier"]:
            lstm = lstm_summary[
                (lstm_summary["experiment"] == experiment) &
                (lstm_summary["horizon"].astype(int) == int(horizon)) &
                (lstm_summary["r"].astype(int) == int(r)) &
                (lstm_summary["contrast"] == contrast) &
                (lstm_summary["metric"] == metric)
            ] if set(["experiment", "horizon", "r", "contrast", "metric"]).issubset(lstm_summary.columns) else pd.DataFrame()
            grud = grud_summary[
                (grud_summary["experiment"] == experiment) &
                (grud_summary["horizon"].astype(int) == int(horizon)) &
                (grud_summary["r"].astype(int) == int(r)) &
                (grud_summary["contrast"] == contrast) &
                (grud_summary["metric"] == metric)
            ]
            if len(lstm) == 0 and len(grud) == 0:
                continue
            lstm_row = lstm.iloc[0] if len(lstm) else pd.Series(dtype=float)
            grud_row = grud.iloc[0] if len(grud) else pd.Series(dtype=float)
            rows.append({
                "Experiment": label,
                "Metric": metric.upper(),
                "LSTM shift": lstm_row.get("mean_difference", np.nan),
                "LSTM seed CI": format_ci(lstm_row.get("student_t_ci95_low", np.nan), lstm_row.get("student_t_ci95_high", np.nan)),
                "GRU-D shift": grud_row.get("mean_difference", np.nan),
                "GRU-D seed CI": format_ci(grud_row.get("student_t_ci95_low", np.nan), grud_row.get("student_t_ci95_high", np.nan)),
                "GRU-D n seeds": grud_row.get("n_seeds", np.nan),
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


lstm_summary = load_lstm_shift_summary_if_available()
model_comparison_table = side_by_side_lstm_grud(lstm_summary, exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary)
show_table("Optional LSTM vs GRU-D shift comparison", model_comparison_table, max_rows=100)
print("Interpretation guardrail: this table is descriptive only; do not claim relative robustness without the actual intervals/results supporting it.")

Final Status Summary¶

def condition_seed_status(experiment, horizon, r, contrast_family):
    if len(exp3_grud_run_results) == 0:
        observed = set()
    else:
        sub = exp3_grud_run_results[
            (exp3_grud_run_results["experiment"] == experiment) &
            (exp3_grud_run_results["horizon"].astype(int) == int(horizon)) &
            (exp3_grud_run_results["target_r"].astype(int) == int(r)) &
            (exp3_grud_run_results["contrast_family"] == contrast_family)
        ]
        by_condition = [set(g["model_seed"].astype(int).tolist()) for _, g in sub.groupby("condition")]
        observed = set.intersection(*by_condition) if by_condition else set()
    return {
        "observed_seeds": sorted(observed),
        "missing_seeds": sorted(EXP3_GRUD_EXPECTED_MODEL_SEEDS - observed),
        "n_seeds": len(observed),
        "complete_seed_set": observed == EXP3_GRUD_EXPECTED_MODEL_SEEDS,
    }


status_specs = [
    ("Exp3A r4", "Exp3A Structured frequency shift", 12, 4, "structured_shift"),
    ("Exp3A r8", "Exp3A Structured frequency shift", 12, 8, "structured_shift"),
    ("Exp3B", "Exp3B Normalizer control", 12, 4, "normalizer_control"),
    ("Exp3C", "Exp3C Random-matched frequency shift", 12, 4, "random_shift"),
    ("Exp3D", "Exp3D Horizon replication", 96, 4, "horizon_replication"),
]
status_rows = []
for label, experiment, horizon, r, family in status_specs:
    row = {"sub_experiment": label, "experiment": experiment, "horizon": horizon, "r": r}
    row.update(condition_seed_status(experiment, horizon, r, family))
    status_rows.append(row)
exp3_grud_final_status = pd.DataFrame(status_rows)
show_table("GRU-D Exp3 final status", exp3_grud_final_status, max_rows=20)

if len(exp3_grud_run_status):
    action_counts = exp3_grud_run_status["prediction_action"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename_axis("prediction_action").reset_index(name="n")
else:
    action_counts = pd.DataFrame(columns=["prediction_action", "n"])
show_table("GRU-D prediction-file actions", action_counts, max_rows=20)

reused_predictions = exp3_grud_run_status[exp3_grud_run_status.get("prediction_action") == "reused"] if len(exp3_grud_run_status) else pd.DataFrame()
generated_predictions = exp3_grud_run_status[exp3_grud_run_status.get("prediction_action").isin(["generated", "regenerated"])] if len(exp3_grud_run_status) else pd.DataFrame()
failed_predictions = exp3_grud_run_status[exp3_grud_run_status.get("prediction_action") == "failed"] if len(exp3_grud_run_status) else pd.DataFrame()
show_table("Reused GRU-D prediction files", reused_predictions[[c for c in ["experiment", "condition", "horizon", "target_r", "model_seed", "prediction_path"] if c in reused_predictions.columns]], max_rows=200)
show_table("Generated/regenerated GRU-D prediction files", generated_predictions[[c for c in ["experiment", "condition", "horizon", "target_r", "model_seed", "prediction_path"] if c in generated_predictions.columns]], max_rows=200)
show_table("Failed GRU-D prediction generations", failed_predictions[[c for c in ["experiment", "condition", "horizon", "target_r", "model_seed", "expected_prediction_path", "missing_reason"] if c in failed_predictions.columns]], max_rows=200)

if len(exp3_grud_train_status):
    incomplete_runs = exp3_grud_train_status[exp3_grud_train_status["complete"] == False]
else:
    incomplete_runs = pd.DataFrame()
show_table("Incomplete GRU-D training runs", incomplete_runs[[c for c in ["run_kind", "horizon", "source_r", "model_seed", "n_epochs", "log_path"] if c in incomplete_runs.columns]], max_rows=200)

final_coverage_rows = []
for experiment, horizon, r, contrast in EXP3_GRUD_MAIN_CONTRASTS + [("Exp3B Normalizer control", 12, 4, "normalizer control")]:
    for metric in EXP3_GRUD_METRICS:
        sub = exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary[
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["experiment"] == experiment) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["horizon"].astype(int) == int(horizon)) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["r"].astype(int) == int(r)) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["contrast"] == contrast) &
            (exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary["metric"] == metric)
        ] if len(exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary) else pd.DataFrame()
        final_coverage_rows.append({
            "experiment": experiment,
            "horizon": horizon,
            "r": r,
            "contrast": contrast,
            "metric": metric,
            "present": len(sub) == 1,
            "n_seeds": int(sub.iloc[0]["n_seeds"]) if len(sub) == 1 else 0,
            "complete_seed_set": bool(sub.iloc[0]["complete_seed_set"]) if len(sub) == 1 else False,
            "final_reporting_ready": bool(len(sub) == 1 and sub.iloc[0]["complete_seed_set"]),
        })
exp3_grud_final_contrast_coverage = pd.DataFrame(final_coverage_rows)
show_table("GRU-D final contrast coverage", exp3_grud_final_contrast_coverage, max_rows=100)

Definitions Recap¶

  • Exp3A: h=12 structured frequency shift for r=4 and r=8. Contrasts compare structured-r -> structured-r against dense -> structured-r.
  • Exp3B: h=12 structured r=4 normalizer control. Contrasts compare the standard structured-r4 train-matched normalizer condition against the structured_r4_dense_norm_control dense-normalizer condition.
  • Exp3C: h=12 random matched-count r=4 with sampling seed 100. Contrasts compare random-r4 -> random-r4 against dense -> random-r4; seed 100 is included in discovery, inference, prediction identity, and filenames.
  • Exp3D: h=96 structured r=4 replication. Contrasts compare structured-r4 -> structured-r4 against dense -> structured-r4.
  • Checkpoint selection always uses validation AUPRC, never test metrics.
  • Normalizers are selected from the training regime, except the deliberate Exp3B dense-normalizer override copied from the LSTM notebook.

Stable summary CSV exports¶

These exports are consumed by visualize_summary.ipynb. They only save dataframes already computed by this source notebook; they do not perform discovery, inference, or checkpoint selection.

Source figures for LSTM vs GRU-D cross-model comparisons¶

These figures are generated in the GRU-D notebook so the cross-model source artifacts live with the raw/irregular Experiment 3E analysis. They load already-computed LSTM result tables from the regular Exp3 notebook outputs; no LSTM models are retrained.

def _read_exp3_csv(filename):
    path = EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / filename
    if not path.exists():
        print("Missing optional cross-model input:", path)
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return pd.read_csv(path)


exp3_lstm_crossmodel_summary = load_lstm_shift_summary_if_available()
exp3e_lstm_raw_shift_summary_for_plots = _read_exp3_csv("experiment3e_lstm_raw_shift_summary.csv")
exp3e_lstm_raw_shift_seed_for_plots = _read_exp3_csv("experiment3e_lstm_raw_shift_seed_level.csv")
exp3_lstm_run_results_for_plots = _read_exp3_csv("experiment3_lstm_condition_run_results.csv")
exp3e_lstm_raw_run_results_for_plots = _read_exp3_csv("experiment3e_lstm_raw_condition_run_results.csv")


def _exp3_summary_row(summary_df, experiment, horizon, r, contrast, metric):
    if summary_df is None or len(summary_df) == 0:
        return None
    required = {"experiment", "horizon", "r", "contrast", "metric"}
    if not required.issubset(summary_df.columns):
        return None
    sub = summary_df[
        (summary_df["experiment"].astype(str) == experiment) &
        (summary_df["horizon"].astype(int) == int(horizon)) &
        (summary_df["r"].astype(int) == int(r)) &
        (summary_df["contrast"].astype(str) == contrast) &
        (summary_df["metric"].astype(str) == metric)
    ]
    if len(sub) == 0:
        return None
    if len(sub) > 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Multiple rows for {} h={} r={} {} {}".format(experiment, horizon, r, contrast, metric))
    return sub.iloc[0]


def _summary_ci(row):
    if row is None:
        return np.nan, np.nan
    for lo, hi in [
        ("patient_bootstrap_ci_low", "patient_bootstrap_ci_high"),
        ("student_t_ci95_low", "student_t_ci95_high"),
        ("seed_ci95_low", "seed_ci95_high"),
        ("ci95_low", "ci95_high"),
    ]:
        if lo in row and hi in row and pd.notna(row.get(lo)) and pd.notna(row.get(hi)):
            return float(row.get(lo)), float(row.get(hi))
    return np.nan, np.nan


def _plot_lstm_grud_contrast_comparison(specs, title, output_name):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(EXP3_CROSSMODEL_METRICS), figsize=(12.8, 3.9), sharey=False)
    plotted = False
    model_summaries = {
        "LSTM": exp3_lstm_crossmodel_summary,
        "GRU-D": exp3_grud_combined_key_contrast_summary,
    }
    offsets = {"LSTM": -0.11, "GRU-D": 0.11}
    for ax, (metric, metric_label) in zip(np.asarray(axes).reshape(-1), EXP3_CROSSMODEL_METRICS):
        labels = [spec["label"] for spec in specs]
        for model, summary_df in model_summaries.items():
            style = EXP3_CROSSMODEL_MODEL_STYLES[model]
            xs, ys, lows, highs = [], [], [], []
            for x, spec in enumerate(specs):
                row = _exp3_summary_row(summary_df, spec["experiment"], spec["horizon"], spec["r"], spec["contrast"], metric)
                if row is None:
                    continue
                y = float(row["mean_difference"])
                lo, hi = _summary_ci(row)
                xs.append(x + offsets[model])
                ys.append(y)
                lows.append(max(y - lo, 0.0) if not np.isnan(lo) else 0.0)
                highs.append(max(hi - y, 0.0) if not np.isnan(hi) else 0.0)
            if xs:
                plotted = True
                ax.errorbar(xs, ys, yerr=np.vstack([lows, highs]), fmt=style["marker"], linestyle="none",
                            capsize=5, color=style["color"], label=model)
        ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linewidth=1, linestyle="--")
        ax.set_xticks(range(len(labels)))
        ax.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=0, ha="center")
        ax.set_title(metric_label)
        ax.set_ylim(*EXP3_CROSSMODEL_YLIMS[metric])
        ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
    axes[0].set_ylabel("Mismatch effect\npositive = matched/left better")
    axes[-1].legend(title="Model")
    fig.suptitle(exp3_grud_title(title), y=1.02)
    fig.tight_layout()
    if not plotted:
        print("Skipping {}: no LSTM/GRU-D rows available.".format(output_name))
        plt.close(fig)
        return
    output_path = EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / output_name
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved:", output_path)

def _raw_shift_summary_for_model(model, metric):
    df = exp3e_lstm_raw_shift_summary_for_plots if model == "LSTM" else exp3e_grud_raw_shift_summary
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return df[df["metric"].astype(str) == metric].copy().sort_values("r")


def _raw_shift_seed_for_model(model, metric, r):
    df = exp3e_lstm_raw_shift_seed_for_plots if model == "LSTM" else exp3e_grud_raw_shift_contrasts
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        return np.asarray([])
    sub = df[(df["metric"].astype(str) == metric) & (df["r"].astype(int) == int(r))]
    return sub["difference"].astype(float).values if "difference" in sub.columns else np.asarray([])


def plot_crossmodel_raw_shift_penalty(metrics=("auroc", "auprc")):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(metrics), figsize=(6.4 * len(metrics), 4.5), sharex=False)
    axes = np.asarray(axes).reshape(-1)
    plotted = False
    offsets = {"LSTM": -0.12, "GRU-D": 0.12}
    labels = {"auroc": "AUROC", "auprc": "AUPRC", "brier": "Brier"}
    for ax, metric in zip(axes, metrics):
        all_rs = sorted(set(_raw_shift_summary_for_model("LSTM", metric).get("r", pd.Series(dtype=int)).astype(int).tolist()) |
                        set(_raw_shift_summary_for_model("GRU-D", metric).get("r", pd.Series(dtype=int)).astype(int).tolist()))
        x_pos = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(all_rs)}
        for model in ["LSTM", "GRU-D"]:
            style = EXP3_CROSSMODEL_MODEL_STYLES[model]
            sub = _raw_shift_summary_for_model(model, metric)
            xs, ys, lows, highs = [], [], [], []
            for _, row in sub.iterrows():
                r = int(row["r"])
                y = float(row["mean_difference"])
                lo, hi = _summary_ci(row)
                x = x_pos[r] + offsets[model]
                xs.append(x)
                ys.append(y)
                lows.append(max(y - lo, 0.0) if not np.isnan(lo) else 0.0)
                highs.append(max(hi - y, 0.0) if not np.isnan(hi) else 0.0)
                points = _raw_shift_seed_for_model(model, metric, r)
                if len(points):
                    ax.scatter(np.repeat(x, len(points)), points, alpha=0.35, s=20, color=style["color"], zorder=2)
            if xs:
                plotted = True
                ax.errorbar(xs, ys, yerr=np.vstack([lows, highs]), fmt=style["marker"], linestyle="none",
                            capsize=5, color=style["color"], label=model, zorder=3)
        ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linewidth=1, linestyle="--")
        ax.set_xticks(range(len(all_rs)))
        ax.set_xticklabels([grud_interval_label(r) for r in all_rs])
        ax.set_xlabel("Raw irregular structured test interval")
        ax.set_ylabel("{} raw shift penalty\nmatched better +".format(labels.get(metric, metric.upper())))
        ax.set_title(labels.get(metric, metric.upper()))
        ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
    axes[-1].legend(title="Model")
    fig.suptitle(exp3_grud_title("Exp3E raw shift penalty: LSTM vs GRU-D"), y=1.03)
    fig.tight_layout()
    if not plotted:
        print("Skipping cross-model raw shift penalty plot: no rows available.")
        plt.close(fig)
        return
    output_path = EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / "experiment3_grud_crossmodel_raw_shift_penalty_auroc_auprc_bootstrap_ci95.png"
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved:", output_path)


def _seed_metric_values(df, condition, r, metric, experiment="Exp3A Structured frequency shift"):
    if df is None or len(df) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["r", "seed", "value"])
    metric_col = "test_{}".format(metric)
    if metric_col not in df.columns:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["r", "seed", "value"])
    sub = df[
        (df["experiment"].astype(str) == experiment) &
        (df["horizon"].astype(int) == 12) &
        (df["target_r"].astype(int) == int(r)) &
        (df["condition"].astype(str) == condition)
    ].copy()
    if len(sub) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["r", "seed", "value"])
    return pd.DataFrame({
        "r": int(r),
        "seed": sub["model_seed"].astype(int).values,
        "value": sub[metric_col].astype(float).values,
    })


def _within_model_grid_raw_seed_values(model, metric):
    if model == "LSTM":
        grid_rows = exp3_lstm_run_results_for_plots
        raw_rows = exp3e_lstm_raw_run_results_for_plots
    elif model == "GRU-D":
        grid_rows = exp3_grud_run_results
        raw_rows = exp3e_grud_raw_run_results
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unknown model {}".format(model))

    available_rs = sorted(
        set(grid_rows.get("target_r", pd.Series(dtype=int)).dropna().astype(int).tolist()) |
        set(raw_rows.get("target_r", pd.Series(dtype=int)).dropna().astype(int).tolist())
    )
    rows = []
    for r in [value for value in available_rs if value in {4, 8}]:
        category_rows = [
            ("matched_grid", _seed_metric_values(
                grid_rows, "structured-r{}->structured-r{}".format(r, r), r, metric)),
            ("mismatched_grid", _seed_metric_values(
                grid_rows, "dense->structured-r{}".format(r), r, metric)),
            ("mismatched_raw", _seed_metric_values(
                raw_rows, "raw-dense->raw-structured-r{}".format(r), r, metric,
                experiment="Exp3E Raw-representation frequency shift")),
        ]
        for category, values in category_rows:
            for _, row in values.iterrows():
                rows.append({
                    "model": model,
                    "r": int(r),
                    "seed": int(row["seed"]),
                    "category": category,
                    "value": float(row["value"]),
                })
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if len(out):
        assert set(out["model"]) == {model}
        assert not out.duplicated(["model", "r", "seed", "category"]).any()
    return out


def _self_check_within_model_grid_raw_seed_values():
    allowed_categories = {"matched_grid", "mismatched_grid", "mismatched_raw"}
    for model in ["LSTM", "GRU-D"]:
        for metric in ["auprc", "auroc"]:
            values = _within_model_grid_raw_seed_values(model, metric)
            if len(values):
                assert values["model"].eq(model).all()
                assert set(values["category"]).issubset(allowed_categories)


_self_check_within_model_grid_raw_seed_values()


def plot_crossmodel_grid_vs_raw_absolute(metrics=("auprc", "auroc")):
    models = ["LSTM", "GRU-D"]
    categories = [
        ("matched_grid", "Regular-grid matched"),
        ("mismatched_grid", "Regular-grid mismatch"),
        ("mismatched_raw", "Raw mismatch"),
    ]
    colors = {
        "matched_grid": "tab:gray",
        "mismatched_grid": "tab:blue",
        "mismatched_raw": "tab:orange",
    }
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(models), len(metrics), figsize=(13.2, 8.6), sharey="col")
    axes = np.asarray(axes).reshape(len(models), len(metrics))
    plotted = False
    for row_index, model in enumerate(models):
        for column_index, metric in enumerate(metrics):
            ax = axes[row_index, column_index]
            seed_values = _within_model_grid_raw_seed_values(model, metric)
            if len(seed_values) == 0:
                ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "NOT AVAILABLE", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", va="center")
                ax.set_axis_off()
                continue
            plotted = True
            summary = seed_values.groupby(["r", "category"])["value"].mean().reset_index()
            rs = sorted(summary["r"].astype(int).unique().tolist())
            x = np.arange(len(rs))
            width = 0.24
            offsets = np.linspace(-width, width, len(categories))
            for offset, (key, label) in zip(offsets, categories):
                means = []
                for r in rs:
                    row = summary[(summary["r"].astype(int) == int(r)) & (summary["category"] == key)]
                    means.append(float(row["value"].iloc[0]) if len(row) else np.nan)
                ax.bar(x + offset, means, width=width, label=label, color=colors[key], alpha=0.68)
                for i, r in enumerate(rs):
                    points = seed_values[(seed_values["r"].astype(int) == int(r)) & (seed_values["category"] == key)]["value"].astype(float).values
                    if len(points):
                        ax.scatter(np.repeat(x[i] + offset, len(points)), points, alpha=0.45, s=22, color="black", zorder=3)
            ax.set_xticks(x)
            ax.set_xticklabels([grud_interval_label(r) for r in rs])
            ax.set_xlabel("Target structured sampling interval")
            ax.set_ylabel("{} absolute performance".format(metric.upper()))
            ax.set_title("{} - {}".format(model, metric.upper()))
            ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
    if not plotted:
        print("Skipping within-model grid/raw absolute-performance figure: no rows available.")
        plt.close(fig)
        return
    handles, labels = axes[0, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    if handles:
        fig.legend(handles, labels, loc="lower center", ncol=len(categories), frameon=False)
    fig.suptitle(exp3_grud_title("Exp3E absolute performance under matched and mismatched observation regimes"), y=0.99)
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.91, bottom=0.12, hspace=0.34, wspace=0.22)
    output_path = EXP3_GRUD_OUTPUT_DIR / "experiment3_grud_crossmodel_grid_vs_raw_absolute_auprc_auroc.png"
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    print("Saved:", output_path)
